watches.name: CVDK Grand Planetarium Eccentric
watches.description: The mechanical planetarium displaying all eight planets in real time, presented in 18 ct rose gold with an aventurine dial.

specsRaw.The difference in scale is considerable: Mercury completes its orbit in 87.97 days, while Neptune requires 164.80 years. Bringing these eight orbital periods together mechanically results in a construction containing a total of 3,338 gear teeth.
